name: project-review-commits
title: Project review commits
description: Use this skill when reviewing committed work across a Git range, especially every commit since the last tag. Assesses per-commit correctness, series coherence, verification, docs, and release readiness without editing files.
when: When reviewing committed work across a Git range or since the last tag
do-not-use-when: Reviewing only uncommitted work before commit — use project-review-worktree
Reviewing an existing PROGRESS.md plan or roadmap without a Git range — use project-review-progress
Creating, editing, squashing, rebasing, tagging, or publishing commits
